claims.text: ADANI ENERGY WINS 25-YEAR BENGAL DEAL FOR 1,750 MW OF ROUND-THE-CLOCK RENEWABLE POWER
claims.llm_reason: The article states Adani Energy won a 25-year deal for 1,750 MW.

claims.text: Adani Energy Solutions said on Saturday, November 21, that its wholly owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd has received a Letter of Award from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd (WBSEDCL) to supply 1,750 MW of renewable energy round-the-clock power for 25 years.
entities: West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd
claims.llm_reason: The article confirms the details about the award and the companies involved.
The article mentions the awarded capacity is 1,750 MW.

claims.text: Round-the-clock renewable power Adani Energy Solutions' subsidiary will supply to West Bengal's state discom for 25 years
claims.llm_reason: The article states the supply is for round-the-clock renewable power for 25 years.
The article specifies the term of the deal is 25 years.

claims.text: Term of the Letter of Award from WBSEDCL, West Bengal's state electricity distributor
claims.llm_reason: The article identifies WBSEDCL as the distributor and confirms the term.
The article mentions the potential total capacity if the greenshoe option is exercised.

claims.text: Total capacity if WBSEDCL exercises the 750 MW greenshoe option on top of the award
